posts.author: rihan_baji
posts.text: LPP limits are very irritating — Hey @siva0 actually, LPP is a bit different from the upper/lower circuit. It’s basically an extra safety check from the exchange to stop orders from getting placed at unusually far-away prices, especially in F&O. The range is dynamic and can change as the contract price moves, so you may see different LPP limits at different times. So this isn’t an extra restriction added from our end. It’s an exchange-level safeguard against accidental or unusual orders. We’ll pass the feedback to the team and see if there’s a better way to show the LPP range. Btw, we’ve also…
